description: Welcome home! Our recently renovated and colorful 3 bedroom / 2 bathrooms flat, located at the heart of Paris city center, perfect for those traveling with children or friends. The neighborhood is safe and family-friendly with plenty to do on your doorstep. The apartment is located in between Le Marais - Les Halles, right by the heart of the French capital!Spacious and central, this apartment will be the ideal holiday spot for your family holidays in Paris.The spaceWelcome to our new property! Historic and bright apartment next to the emblematic centre of Paris, an ideal spot for art and culture lovers, containing some of the most emblematic monuments and museums of the city.The apartment has been under another owners management, as new owner of the apartment I will make sure you have even a more memorable stay! This 80m2 apartment features a bright and comfy living area with its own dinning table ideal for a family gathering and opened to a well-equipped and very modern kitchen. The rooms have been thoughtfully designed with colorful touches, and nice decoration. The apartment has a capacity for up to 8 people distributed in 3 bedrooms:- Bedroom 1: 1 Double bed - Bedroom 2: 1 Double bed - Bedroom 3: 1 Double bed - Living room: Double sofa bed Some special features:- The apartment is accessed via a very nice and quiet street, it faces an interior courtyard and all rooms are very quiet! - The bedroom closer to the living room can be closed thanks to a sliding door. - It is located on a 3rd floor and the building has elevator. - Cozy living room with an open layout to a well equipped kitchen- The living room counts with a portable AC unit that helps to cool down the entire place and electric heaters for winter. - Washer and Dryier available inside the apartment. - 2 bathr
